raytrace_new_vs_historical_full.interpretation: sphere_shadow is slower than the historical full implementation. Similar baselines support this direction, but the sessions are nine days apart and this is not a direct interleaved ablation. Chosen scope/simplicity is a valid rationale; superior measured speed is not.
raytrace_new_vs_historical_full.scene_validation_note: sphere_shadow stock_scene generator95994 resumptions and all10666 versus historical full9 and1 because cached scene classification was supplied by full render wrapper. Do not attribute whole17.27%gap solely to named extra micro-optimizations.

limitations: perf text and CSV files were generated by separate repeated invocations. Values here consistently use text reports, matching saved comparison/counters.txt.
Clean timing uses release python3; native cycle profiles use python3-dbg. cProfile is separate and timings are inflated.
Most PMU hardware events were multiplexed at roughly40–60% running time; cache/TLB and miss-rate details are approximate, not precise causal fractions.
Topdown contains negative percentages and is rejected; LLC-load counters unsupported. Neither exact memory-bound fraction nor zero DRAM stalls is established.

Flame widths are within-profile sample fractions, not wall-clock durations. Depth is native call depth, not duration, and repeating CPython chains do not identify a Python source line without additional attribution.
No lost native samples were reported, but symbolization/unwind may still be incomplete. Samples include startup/imports.
Baseline official pyperformance run is present; optimized wrapper is a matched custom timing harness, not an official optimized pyperformance entry.
Manifests record upstream hashes but pyperformance extraction-version field is UNVERIFIED. Independent source provenance should be documented separately.
Current nbody kernel, wrapper and upstream hashes match measured files; current shared pipeline hash differs after later raytrace default changes.

raytrace.note: Same geometry counts as historical full. Boundary counts depend on chosen hardware API; sphere_queries/7 is not measured crossings because shadows exit early.

nbody.exact_arithmetic: Upstream pow expression retained; flat_sqrt is approximate and excluded from exact default.
